title: Repair Positions Are Retrieved, Then Checked Exactly
core_message: The candidate engine narrows the search without weakening capacity or time-window feasibility.

cards.title: Feature encoding
cards.body: Each candidate position carries spatial, temporal, capacity, and workload context.

cards.title: Approximate retrieval
cards.body: HNSW returns a short list of positions that are likely to be useful.

cards.title: Exact filtering
cards.body: Capacity and time-window feasibility checks stay in the repair path.

cards.title: Objective selection
cards.body: Surviving candidates are scored by distance alone or by distance plus equity.

title: The Figure Lane Starts Below the Measured Lede
core_message: A PDF-derived architecture figure must share the same header reservation as the explanation lane, even when the lede wraps to several lines.

cards.title: Single header owner
cards.body: Title and lede heights are measured before either content lane is positioned.

cards.title: Independent content
cards.body: The figure and explanation can resize only inside their assigned sibling regions.

title: Equity Improves Without Occupying the Footer Reserve
core_message: Dense results remain inside the content plate and preserve a dedicated final band for the page number.

cards.title: Distance
cards.body: The cost delta remains bounded across the measured repair configurations.

cards.title: Balance
cards.body: Route workloads become more even as the equity term receives more weight.

cards.title: Result
cards.body: The selected operating point improves workload balance while accepting a controlled increase in total distance.

title: The Result Callout Is a Peer Region, Not an Overlay
core_message: Every painted panel owns non-overlapping geometry; no bottom callout may collide with the canvases above it.

cards.title: Observed
cards.body: The measured result is presented in the primary evidence lane.

cards.title: Compared
cards.body: The baseline and equitable alternatives occupy a separate sibling lane.

cards.title: Result
cards.body: The conclusion remains fully visible without crossing another panel or the footer.

title: One Objective Connects Cost and Workload Equity
core_message: The scalarized repair objective makes the cost-equity trade-off explicit.
formula_terms: J(R)=repair objective; R=set of vehicle routes; C(R)=candidate solution cost; C_0=initial solution cost; beta=equity weight; Jain(R)=workload fairness index; gamma=variation weight; CV(R)=coefficient of variation of route distances
formula_gloss: Increasing equity weights favors more balanced route workloads while accepting a potentially higher total distance.

title: A Deterministic Recovery Ladder Reflows Before It Rejects
core_message: Every attempt is measured against the same plate and readability contract.

cards.title: Compose
cards.body: Choose a supported semantic composition with explicit regions.

cards.title: Measure
cards.body: Inspect browser-resolved text, overflow, paint bounds, and collisions.

cards.title: Recover
cards.body: Try the compact component variant and bounded copy shortening.

cards.title: Gate
cards.body: Reject the draft if any hard geometry violation remains.
